Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — ClearVector onboarding call today. Procurement wants a concise SLA/SLO summary + a worked credit example for P99 latency breaches. Can we get a short customer-facing doc by EOD?
Ethan (SRE): I can pull metrics. They're on hosted (prod-west) for the trial. P99 target is 300ms, right? I suggest baseline = last 30d with a 7d rolling highlight.
Priya (CS Ops): Contract shows 99.9% uptime + P99 <= 300ms for inference API. They move to Dedicated in ~60 days. Need onboarding status note in the doc.
Jamal (AE): Reminder — procurement will push on credit calc. Renewal risk increases if perceived instability during trial. Recommend we include fallback options (regional routing/model variant) in the one-pager.
Maya (CS): Agreed. For the one-pager we need: 1) How uptime is measured (customer traffic only), 2) Latency calc (P99 method), 3) Sample credit table and example, 4) Evidence bundle (charts + query). Priya/Ethan volunteers?
Ethan (SRE): I'll post the Prometheus query + a sample p99 chart by 15:00. Example query: `histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{customer="clearvector"}[5m])) by (le))` — use 5m windows aggregated into 7d rolling for the doc.
ops-bot: Runbook update: Onboard runbook v1.2 edited by @Ethan — https://runbooks.redwood/onboard-clearvector (view-only)
Priya (CS Ops): Drafting the one-pager now. I'll include the SLA formula and a simple credit example: e.g., if monthly uptime <99.9% then credit = (99.9% - actual_uptime)% * monthly committed fee. I'll flesh out numbers.
Jamal (AE): Legal wants this clause verbatim in the doc: "SLA credits are the customer's sole and exclusive remedy" — @Nadia can you confirm acceptable phrasing?
Nadia (Legal): I will review. Prefer: "SLA credits constitute the sole monetary remedy for unavailability under this agreement." Send the draft and I'll mark any edits.
Maya (CS): Timeline: Ethan -> metrics + chart by 15:00, Priya -> draft one-pager in thread by 16:30, Nadia -> legal sign-off before 17:30, Jamal -> final to procurement after sign-off. Any blockers?
Ethan (SRE): No blockers. Also will attach last incident note (2026-03-04) and mitigation actions to the evidence bundle.
Priya (CS Ops): Uploaded draft to drive: https://drive.redwood/clearvector-sla-draft (placeholder). Included sample credit calc with numbers: monthly invoice $12,000 -> one hour outage at scale X -> credit calc example.
Jamal (AE): Perfect. I'll prep the procurement email template once legal clears.
Maya (CS): Thanks all :raised_hands: — if anything urgent ping me or @Jamal. I'll update customer after we get legal sign-off.
